question: In a certain code language, 'COBBLESTONES' is written as 'BBOCTSELSENO' , and 'SATISFACTORY' is written as 'ITASCAFSYROT'. How will 'TACHYCARDIAS' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Arranged the letters diagonally in the group of four.

So,

'COBBLESTONES' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d9866a77b0bf24dc14e6c90dae691160b1fa5edeb0a7fd74d924a6b7bd26545.png] 

'SATISFACTORY' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97b372af64a26b3b035776da309b110d57c2d41ef76f90c379fb5516ab8edd51.png] 

Similarly,

'TACHYCARDIAS' is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa1753ce4efee527c1403d053ae1a65cdebb1711e59184b31957861deef3b25c.png] 

Hence, **"HCATRACYSAID"** is the correct answer.
